1	const Position = require('../models/Position')
2	const Transaction = require('../models/Transaction')
3	const { getQuotes, invalidateCache } = require('../services/stockService')
4	
5	exports.getPortfolio = async (req, res) => {
6	  try {
7	    const positions = await Position.find({ user: req.user._id })
8	    if (!positions.length) return res.json({ positions: [], totalValue: 0, totalCost: 0 })
9	
10	    const tickers = positions.map((p) => p.ticker)
11	    const quotes = await getQuotes(tickers)
12	    const quoteMap = {}
13	    quotes.forEach((q) => { if (q) quoteMap[q.ticker] = q })
14	
15	    const totals = {}
16	
17	    const enriched = positions.map((p) => {
18	      const q = quoteMap[p.ticker] || {}
19	      const currency = p.ticker.toUpperCase().endsWith('.TA') ? 'ILS' : 'USD'
20	      const currentPrice = q.price || 0
21	      const value = currentPrice * p.shares
22	      const cost = p.avgCost * p.shares
23	      const pnl = value - cost
24	      const pnlPercent = cost > 0 ? (pnl / cost) * 100 : 0
25	
26	      if (!totals[currency]) totals[currency] = { value: 0, cost: 0 }
27	      totals[currency].value += value
28	      totals[currency].cost += cost
29	
30	      return {
31	        _id: p._id,
32	        ticker: p.ticker,
33	        currency,
34	        companyName: q.name || p.companyName,
35	        shares: p.shares,
36	        avgCost: p.avgCost,
37	        currentPrice,
38	        value,
39	        cost,
40	        pnl,
41	        pnlPercent,
42	        change: q.change,
43	        changePercent: q.changePercent,
44	      }
45	    })
46	
47	    const totalsArray = Object.entries(totals).map(([currency, t]) => ({
48	      currency,
49	      value: t.value,
50	      cost: t.cost,
51	      pnl: t.value - t.cost,
52	      pnlPercent: t.cost > 0 ? ((t.value - t.cost) / t.cost) * 100 : 0,
53	    }))
54	
55	    res.json({ positions: enriched, totals: totalsArray })
